I was at systems training course a few years ago and our instructor was late coming back from lunch, like 30 minutes late. During that time we came up with the idea to turn the clock in the room ahead and hour just to mess with the instructor. After a little more time went by we decided we needed to change the time on the server so the computers in the room also had the time ahead an hour, so at that point everything in the room said the time was ahead an hour. The instructor finally returns, looks at the clock, ponders it a little bit and apologizes profusely for being so late. The end of class comes and the instructor apologizes again for being late and how we didn't cover all the material we were supposed to for that day. Our prank wasn't going as planned since he never picked up on the time being off and now we were going to get out an hour earlier than we were supposed to. At that point someone told the instructor to check his watch. He did and got a bewildered look on his face and then looked up at the clock. At that point I blurted out, "We changed the time on your watch!", and the instructor got a terrified look on his face and immediately checked his back pocket for his wallet! We then explained what happened. He was kind of upset with us about our prank, but by the next day he was laughing about it and said that one would go down in the history books of the company.
